---
applyTo: '**/*.scss'
---

# SCSS Conventions

## Design Tokens

All visual values (colors, spacing, font sizes, shadows, radii, gradients) come from `--rds--*` CSS custom properties. Never hardcode hex colors, pixel values, or font stacks.

```scss
// Correct
color: var(--rds--color-primary);
gap: var(--rds--spacing-large);
font-size: var(--rds--font-size-large);
border-radius: var(--rds--radius-md);

// Wrong
color: #e91c24;
gap: 1.5rem;
```

Token reference: `src/styles/files/rds-tokens.css` (generated by c2b — do not edit).

## Class Naming

- BEM with `cu-` prefix: `.cu-component`, `.cu-component--modifier`, `.cu-component__element`
- Utility classes use `cu-utils--` prefix

## Responsive Breakpoints

CSS custom properties **cannot** be used inside `@media` queries (spec limitation). Breakpoint values come in via SCSS variables from `_variables.scss`.

```scss
@use '../../styles/files/variables' as *;

.cu-column--two {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;

    @media (width > $rds-media-query-md) {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }
}
```

Available breakpoint variables:

- `$rds-media-query-sm` — 600px (c2b `viewport.mobile`)
- `$rds-media-query-md` — 784px (c2b `viewport.tablet`)
- `$rds-media-query-lg` — 960px
- `$rds-media-query-xl` — 1280px

Mobile-first: default styles are mobile, use `(width > $breakpoint)` media queries to enhance. Use range syntax, not `min-width`: a viewport exactly at a breakpoint gets the smaller-screen styles, matching WordPress's `@mobile`/`@tablet` block styles. For the rare max-width case use the exact complement, `(width <= $breakpoint)` — no `- 0.02px` offsets.

## SCSS Variables

Always `@use` `src/styles/files/_variables.scss`. It is hand-maintained: it forwards the generated `_rds-variables.scss` and defines the `$rds-media-query-*` names. `sm`/`md` come from the c2b `viewport` tokens (which also set WordPress `settings.viewport`); `lg`/`xl` have no c2b category and are declared there directly.

`_rds-variables.scss` is auto-generated by component2block from the `scssVars` list in `c2b.config.json`. It currently includes the `viewport` and `spacing` categories. Add more categories there if you need them as SCSS variables (rather than CSS custom properties) — e.g., for use in `calc()` that can't resolve CSS vars, or for conditional SCSS logic. Never edit it directly — run `pnpm c2b` to regenerate.

## File Locations

- Component styles: `src/components/ComponentName/styles.scss`
- Global/base styles: `src/styles/files/`
- Generated (do not edit): `src/styles/files/`
- Main entry: `src/styles/main.scss` (aggregates everything for the `dist/style.css` bundle)
